theme.en: AI Infrastructure Reshapes Packaging and Memory Demand
theme.zh: AI基础设施重塑封装与存储需求

dek.en: Microsoft's EMIB commitment gives Intel a named advanced-packaging customer, while DDR6 previews a new bandwidth step. HBM price forecasts and falling consumer NAND prices point to divergent conditions across the memory market.
dek.zh: 微软采用EMIB，为英特尔先进封装业务带来明确客户，DDR6规格预览则展示了下一阶段的带宽提升方向。HBM涨价预测与消费级NAND价格回落，显示存储市场不同领域的供需正在分化。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Bull Shows Diamond Rapids Package in Sequana Platform at SC26
title.zh: Bull在SC26展示Sequana平台中的Diamond Rapids封装

summary.en: Bull displayed Intel's Xeon Diamond Rapids LGA9324 package in its Sequana XH31600 platform at SC26, ServeTheHome reports. The demonstration gives a concrete view of the processor's platform integration as server vendors prepare their next systems. A package display does not establish production availability or measured application performance.
summary.zh: 据ServeTheHome报道，Bull在SC26上展示了Sequana XH31600平台中的英特尔Xeon Diamond Rapids LGA9324封装。这让外界能够具体观察服务器厂商为下一代系统准备的处理器集成方案。封装展示本身尚不能说明量产供货时间或实测应用性能。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Microsoft Commits to Intel EMIB for Azure Custom Silicon
title.zh: 微软为Azure自研芯片采用英特尔EMIB封装

summary.en: Microsoft became the first publicly announced customer for Intel Foundry's EMIB advanced packaging for its custom silicon, according to Wccftech. The expanded collaboration also includes a multiyear Xeon capacity commitment covering Diamond Rapids. The agreement gives Intel a named customer for its packaging services; that commitment is distinct from a wafer-fabrication award.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，微软成为首家公开宣布为自研芯片采用Intel Foundry EMIB先进封装的客户。双方扩大的合作还包括覆盖Diamond Rapids的多年Xeon产能协议。这为英特尔封装服务带来明确客户，但封装合作与晶圆制造订单属于不同业务。

title.en: Memory & Storage
title.zh: 存储器与存储系统

title.en: JEDEC Previews DDR6 at 12.8–14.4 GT/s
title.zh: JEDEC预览DDR6规格，速率为12.8至14.4 GT/s

summary.en: JEDEC previewed DDR6 specifications starting at 12.8 GT/s and extending to 14.4 GT/s, Wccftech reports. The preview covers UDIMM, RDIMM and CAMM designs, placing the next memory generation across desktop, server and compact-system formats. DDR6 remains in development, so these specifications describe a roadmap rather than current shipping-module availability.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，JEDEC预览DDR6规格，起始速率为12.8 GT/s，并可扩展至14.4 GT/s。预览涉及UDIMM、RDIMM和CAMM设计，使下一代内存覆盖桌面、服务器及紧凑型系统等形态。DDR6仍在开发中，这些规格反映的是技术路线，并不表示相应模组已经上市供货。

title.en: Consumer NAND Prices Fall 20%, With Further Declines Forecast
title.zh: 消费级NAND价格下跌20%，明年初或继续回落

summary.en: Consumer NAND spot prices have fallen 20%, and a further 5–10% decline is expected in early 2027, Wccftech reports. Lower component prices could ease costs for SSD, laptop and smartphone makers after a period of pressure on consumer storage. Spot-market declines do not necessarily pass immediately into contract prices or retail SSD prices.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，消费级NAND现货价格已下跌20%，预计2027年初还将下降5%至10%。在消费级存储经历价格压力之后，元件价格回落有望缓解SSD、笔记本电脑和智能手机厂商的成本。现货市场降价未必会立即传导至合约价或SSD零售价。

title.en: Report Forecasts Latest HBM Prices at Up to 2.7 Times Current Levels
title.zh: 报道预测新一代HBM明年价格最高达当前的2.7倍

summary.en: Seoul Economic Daily reports that prices for the latest HBM could reach as much as 2.7 times current levels next year. If realized, the increase would raise the memory bill for AI accelerators and complicate system cost planning. The figure is a forecast for the latest HBM, rather than an observed increase across all memory products.
summary.zh: 《首尔经济日报》报道称，新一代HBM明年的价格可能最高达到当前水平的2.7倍。若预测兑现，AI加速器的存储成本将上升，系统成本规划也会更加复杂。这一数字是针对新一代HBM的预测，并非所有存储产品已经发生的普遍涨价。

title.en: Silicon Motion Demonstrates Gen5 and Gen6 Enterprise SSD Platforms
title.zh: 慧荣展示PCIe Gen5与Gen6企业级SSD平台

summary.en: Silicon Motion is demonstrating PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 MonTitan enterprise SSD controllers and reference platforms at SC26 in Chicago. The systems target AI factories, agentic AI and large-scale inference, bringing storage-controller development into the same infrastructure discussion as processors and memory. The supplied report describes demonstrations, without establishing shipment volumes or customer deployments.
summary.zh: 慧荣在芝加哥SC26上展示PCIe Gen5和Gen6 MonTitan企业级SSD控制器及参考平台。这些方案面向AI工厂、智能体AI和大规模推理，使存储控制器开发成为处理器与内存之外的另一项基础设施议题。所提供的报道介绍了现场演示，尚未给出出货规模或客户部署情况。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Lam Examines Atomic Layer Etch for Three-Dimensional Structures
title.zh: 泛林探讨三维结构制造中的原子层刻蚀

summary.en: Lam Research published a technical discussion of atomic layer etch for three-dimensional semiconductor structures. The subject addresses the need for controlled material removal as device geometry becomes more complex. This is a process-technology discussion, with no new tool order or quantified manufacturing result established by the supplied excerpt.
summary.zh: 泛林发布技术文章，讨论面向三维半导体结构的原子层刻蚀。随着器件几何形状日益复杂，如何精确控制材料去除成为重要工艺问题。这是一篇工艺技术讨论，所提供的摘要未涉及新增设备订单或量化制造成果。

title.en: Policy & Export Controls
title.zh: 政策与出口管制

title.en: Commerce Rule Targets Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors
title.zh: 美国商务部新规针对先进半导体远程访问

summary.en: Morgan Lewis reports that a new Commerce Department interim final rule targets remote access to advanced semiconductors. The development puts access to computing resources, alongside physical chip shipments, at the center of export-control scrutiny. The supplied excerpt does not identify the detailed thresholds, exceptions or effective dates.
summary.zh: 据Morgan Lewis报道，美国商务部一项新的临时最终规则针对先进半导体的远程访问。这意味着除芯片实物出货外，计算资源的访问方式也成为出口管制审查的重点。所提供的摘要尚未列出具体门槛、例外情形或生效日期。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: SambaNova Plans to Triple SambaStack Deployment at TACC
title.zh: SambaNova扩大TACC合作，SambaStack部署规模增至3倍

summary.en: SambaNova announced an expanded partnership with the Texas Advanced Computing Center that triples its SambaStack deployment for scientific AI. The named installation provides a concrete expansion signal for an alternative AI computing platform in research infrastructure. A threefold deployment increase does not by itself establish a threefold application-performance gain.
summary.zh: SambaNova宣布扩大与得克萨斯先进计算中心（TACC）的合作，将面向科学AI的SambaStack部署规模增至3倍。这项有明确机构参与的部署扩展，为替代性AI计算平台进入科研基础设施提供了具体信号。部署规模增至3倍，并不意味着应用性能也同步提升至3倍。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Depends on the Whole System
theme.zh: 推理效率取决于整个系统

dek.en: Eight papers connect quantization and accelerator design with interconnects, production workloads and evaluation methods. The reading queue combines conference publications with preprints and distinguishes measured results from architectural proposals.
dek.zh: 本期8篇论文将量化和加速器设计，与互连、生产负载及评测方法联系起来。阅读清单同时纳入会议论文和预印本，并区分实测结果与架构方案。

title.en: Accelerator Architecture & Systems
title.zh: 加速器架构与系统

title.en: Chimera Co-Designs FPGA Compute, HBM Access and Floorplan for LLM Decode
title.zh: Chimera协同设计FPGA计算、HBM访问与布局以支持大模型解码

papers.authors: Zhi-Heng Chen, Yi-Fan Zhang, Yuseon Chou, et al.

summary.en: Chimera co-designs compute lanes, HBM access and placement across the dies of an FPGA, using HBM Proxy Ports to reach compute in every super logic region. On an AMD Alveo U280, the authors build ten designs for eight models, including an 80B-parameter MoE model using four memory tiers. The work addresses the routing and resource limits that prevent raw HBM bandwidth from becoming useful decode throughput; the supplied abstract does not include comparative performance figures.
summary.zh: Chimera在多裸片FPGA上协同设计计算通路、HBM访问与布局，通过HBM Proxy Ports让各个超级逻辑区域中的计算资源都能访问HBM。作者在AMD Alveo U280上为8个模型构建了10种设计，其中包括使用4级存储的800亿参数MoE模型。这项工作针对布线和资源约束，解决HBM标称带宽难以充分转化为解码吞吐的问题；所提供的摘要尚未包含对比性能数字。

title.en: Mutable Inference Shares Accelerator Resources Between Prediction and Learning
title.zh: Mutable Inference在预测与学习之间共享加速器资源

papers.authors: Yi-Min Gao, Liang-Tao Dai, Melika Morsali, et al.

summary.en: Learning While Serving shares accelerator compute between latency-critical prediction and more flexible inference-time learning. It exploits matrix capacity left idle by non-matrix attention operations and uses per-layer weight versioning so updates can coexist with in-flight computations. The architecture targets models that learn from context during inference, making it relevant to hardware beyond fixed-weight decoding; no silicon measurement is established by the supplied abstract.
summary.zh: Learning While Serving让延迟敏感的预测与时间安排更灵活的推理时学习共享加速器计算资源。它利用注意力非矩阵运算期间闲置的矩阵计算能力，并通过逐层权重版本管理，使权重更新与尚未完成的计算并存。该架构面向推理过程中持续从上下文学习的模型，将硬件设计问题扩展到固定权重解码之外；所提供的摘要尚未给出芯片实测结果。

title.en: Two DGX Sparks Favor Different Parallelism at Different Loads
title.zh: 双DGX Spark在不同负载下适合不同并行方式

papers.authors: Kevin Bhimani, Christian Escobar, Daniel Mihovch, et al.

summary.en: Across 17 checkpoints on one or two DGX Spark GB10 systems linked by 200 GbE, tensor parallelism delivered a median 1.59× peak-throughput gain over one system, versus 1.39× for pipeline parallelism. Tensor parallelism also cut unloaded inter-token latency to 0.52–0.73× of the single-system value. For models fitting on one system, replication generally offered higher throughput at high concurrency, so the best way to add a second machine depends on the serving load.
summary.zh: 研究在1台或2台通过200 GbE互连的DGX Spark GB10上测试了17个模型检查点；相较单机，张量并行的峰值吞吐增益中位数为1.59倍，流水线并行为1.39倍。张量并行还将无负载条件下的词元间延迟降至单机的0.52至0.73倍。对于单机能够容纳的模型，高并发下复制部署通常提供更高吞吐，因此第二台机器的最佳使用方式取决于服务负载。

title.en: Quantization, KV Cache & Inference Systems
title.zh: 量化、KV缓存与推理系统

title.en: Beyond Bitwidth Tests Mixed Precision Against Real Blackwell Deployment Limits
title.zh: Beyond Bitwidth按Blackwell实际部署约束评测混合精度量化

summary.en: For Qwen3-8B on an Nvidia B200 with vLLM, a configuration combining 98 NVFP4 weight-only modules, 46 INT8 modules and an INT8 output head passed the study's held-out quality and deployment gates. With 16-bit activations, it used 5.917 GiB for weight loading and achieved a time-per-output-token ratio of 0.939 relative to BF16. All seven tested INT2 grids degenerated during generation, showing why nominal bitwidth alone is a poor deployment criterion. The passing configuration remains a result for this model, hardware and evaluation set.
summary.zh: 研究在英伟达B200与vLLM上测试Qwen3-8B，将98个仅权重采用NVFP4的模块、46个INT8模块及INT8输出头组合后，通过了独立保留测试集上的质量与部署门槛。在激活保持16位的条件下，该配置的权重加载内存为5.917 GiB，每输出词元耗时为BF16基线的0.939倍。测试的7组INT2配置均出现生成退化，说明名义位宽不足以作为部署标准。通过门槛的结果仍限于这一模型、硬件和评测集。

title.en: RoShift Turns Activation Sparsity into Measured Decode Speedups
title.zh: RoShift将激活稀疏性转化为实测解码加速

papers.authors: Geunsoo Song, Jiwon Seo, Hoeseok Yang, et al.

summary.en: RoShift combines a deferred activation shift with weight-aware rotation to create sparsity without training, then fuses the required corrections to preserve decode efficiency. Across five models, it improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points at 50% and 60% sparsity, respectively. On an RTX 5090, the authors report up to 1.72× decoding speed over the dense model at 50% sparsity. The measured speedup connects skipped weight reads to runtime, but its maximum is specific to the tested configuration.
summary.zh: RoShift通过延迟执行补偿的激活平移与权重感知旋转，在无需训练的情况下提高稀疏性，并融合必要的补偿运算以保持解码效率。在5个模型上，50%和60%稀疏度下的平均准确率分别比TEAL高1.60和3.29个百分点。作者报告，在RTX 5090上以50%稀疏度运行时，解码速度最高为稠密模型的1.72倍。实测加速将减少权重读取与运行时间联系起来，但最高收益仅对应所测试的具体配置。

title.en: HACK Computes Attention Directly on INT2 KV Cache
title.zh: HACK直接在INT2 KV缓存上计算注意力

papers.authors: Ze-Yu Zhang, Hai-Ying Shen, S. Vargaftik, et al.

summary.en: HACK keeps KV data in compressed INT2 form for transfer and caching, and computes attention directly on that representation in disaggregated inference. This targets both the network cost of moving KV between prefill and decode and the repeated dequantization cost of conventional low-bit caching. The supplied abstract establishes the mechanism but does not expose quantitative accuracy or end-to-end latency results.
summary.zh: HACK在分离式推理中，以压缩后的INT2格式传输和缓存KV数据，并直接在该表示上计算注意力。它同时针对预填充与解码阶段之间搬运KV的网络成本，以及传统低位宽缓存反复反量化的开销。所提供的摘要说明了技术机制，但尚未给出量化精度或端到端延迟的具体结果。

title.en: Production MaaS Trace Maps Resource Allocation Across More Than 100,000 GPUs
title.zh: 生产级MaaS轨迹分析覆盖逾10万颗GPU的资源分配

papers.authors: Yin Zheng, Ling-Yun Yang, Ying-Hao Yu, et al.

summary.en: A six-month trace from the xMaaS production platform covers more than 100,000 GPUs, 300,000 applications and 70,000 model variants. The study examines cluster-wide resource supply, changing application demand and deployment choices across heterogeneous GPUs, extending characterization beyond individual requests. This scale makes the workload evidence useful for judging serving-system assumptions, although the supplied excerpt does not report utilization rates or a demonstrated scheduling gain.
summary.zh: 研究分析xMaaS生产平台长达6个月的运行轨迹，覆盖逾10万颗GPU、30万个应用和7万个模型变体。它从整个集群层面考察资源供给、应用需求变化和异构GPU上的部署选择，将负载刻画从单个请求扩展到资源分配。这一规模的生产数据有助于检验推理服务系统的设计假设，但所提供的摘要尚未报告利用率数字或已验证的调度收益。

title.en: LLM Inference Evaluation Study Exposes Baseline and Metric Pitfalls
title.zh: 大模型推理评测研究揭示基线与指标设计缺陷

papers.authors: Amey Agrawal, Nitin Kedia, Anmol Agarwal, et al.
papers.venue: ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing 2026, Volume 1

summary.en: This study identifies recurring inference-evaluation problems in baseline fairness, workload setup and metric design. It explains how implementation differences can obscure algorithmic contributions and how normalized metrics can hide variability in autoregressive token delivery. The analysis provides a useful checklist for assessing accelerator and serving claims, particularly when prefill, decode and user-visible latency are combined into a single headline number.
summary.zh: 这项研究梳理了推理评测在基线公平性、负载设置和指标设计上的常见问题。它说明，实现细节的差异可能掩盖算法本身的贡献，而归一化指标也可能隐藏自回归词元输出的波动。这些分析有助于审视加速器与推理服务的性能主张，尤其适用于预填充、解码及用户感知延迟被合并成单一宣传数字的情况。
